findings.summary: Loading state is a bare text paragraph 'جارٍ التحميل…' instead of the shared LoadingScreen / skeleton pattern used across the app.
findings.fix:
Replace the `

جارٍ التحميل…

` fallback with `` (or a card skeleton) for consistency with the rest of the app.

findings.summary: The modal close button is an icon-only '✕' glyph with no aria-label, so screen readers announce nothing meaningful.
findings.fix: Add `aria-label="إغلاق"` (and ideally the `icon-button` class or lucide X icon) to the close `<button type="button">`.

findings.summary: The modal dialog lacks dialog semantics (no role="dialog", aria-modal, aria-labelledby) and no focus/escape handling.
findings.fix: Add `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby` referencing the heading id to the modal wrapper for accessible modal semantics.

findings.summary: Modal overlay uses hardcoded Tailwind color `bg-slate-950/60` instead of a design token, breaking token consistency and dark-theme adaptability.
findings.fix: Use a token-based scrim, e.g. a defined overlay token or `bg-[var(--surface-strong)]/60`, instead of `bg-slate-950/60`.

findings.summary: The Save button `<button className="btn-primary">حفظ الجدولة</button>` omits `type="submit"` and has no pending/disabled state during the async mutation.
findings.fix: Add `type="submit"` and disable/show a spinner while `commands.upsert.isPending` to match the app's form submission pattern.

findings.summary: Form field labels use a bespoke inline `Field` component rather than shared label styling, and the 'channels' draft state is never editable in the form.
findings.fix: Align Field markup with the shared label styling used elsewhere; either expose a channels selector or drop the unused channels UI concern.

findings.summary: The schedules and runs lists have no search/filter affordance despite potentially long lists, diverging from the FilterBar pattern used on comparable list pages.
findings.fix: Add a FilterBar (search + result count) above the schedules list if the dataset can grow, for consistency with other management list pages.

findings.summary: Multiple statements and JSX are collapsed onto single very long lines, hurting readability and diff-ability versus the rest of the codebase.
findings.fix: Split the component body, header JSX, and modal form onto normally-formatted multi-line JSX consistent with sibling files.
